title: SWF compile: DefineFontInfo2 (tag 62) never emitted — device font fallback missing
description: Neither tag 62 (DefineFontInfo2) nor tag 13 (DefineFontInfo) is emitted by compile.ts or fonts.ts. Without DefineFontInfo2, the Flash Player cannot associate the embedded font's character table with a specific system font name for device-font fallback rendering. Fix: in packages/swf/src/fonts.ts, add encodeDefineFontInfo2(fontId, fontName, bold, italic, charCodes) that writes tag 62 per SWF spec. In compile.ts, after emitting each DefineFont2/3 for a font family, follow it with a DefineFontInfo2 tag with the font name and the set of character codes used. This enables UseDeviceFonts rendering path in the Flash Player.
